The '''Kurosti merchant fleet'''<ref name="EGTW" /> originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Kurost system/Legends|Kurost system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Kurost sector/Legends|Kurost sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]], [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] forces under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the [[Harch/Legends|Harch]] military leader [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] captured the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] during a daring [[Raid at Prospera Jang|raid]] at the celestial body [[Prospera Jang]]<ref name="EGTW" /> in the Kurost [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Prospera Jang system/Legends|same name]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kurosti merchant fleet was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
